title: Descent of an augmentation through its universal cochain counit
statement: Let A,B be abelian categories with independently chosen derived categories, E:A→B additive, V:B→A additive exact, and F a pointwise left derived functor of E with specified universal cochain counit ε. Suppose V^D is a right adjoint. Let P be a resolving class on which ε is invertible. For H:Ch(A)→Ch(A) preserving quasi-isomorphisms, j:Id→H, and a:H→E^Ch V^Ch a quasi-isomorphism on P, there exist a localized H^D, localized j, and a natural isomorphism H^D≅F V^D whose component followed by V^D(ε) and the exact-restriction factor is precisely the localization of a.

source.place: Tags 0FND, 09T5, 06XN and 05SU; derived adjunction and universal cochain counit.

proof.text: Localize HQ and j using the localization universal property. Since V^D is a right adjoint, it preserves limits, so it preserves the pointwise right Kan extension defining the left derived functor. Compose its counit with the exact-functor comparison. The universal property lifts the localized a to H^D→F V^D, with the asserted component equation. On P its two counits are invertible, so the lifted component is invertible. Resolve each complex and use naturality to propagate invertibility to its localization. Essential surjectivity of Q gives invertibility on every derived object.

theorem exists_cochainAugmentationDescent
    {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    {B : Type u'} [Category.{v'} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} B]
    (E : A ⥤ B) [E.Additive] (V : B ⥤ A) [V.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits V] [PreservesFiniteColimits V]
    (F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory B)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ⟶ E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    [F.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso A (.up ℤ))]
    [(E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).HasPointwiseLeftDerivedFunctor
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso A (.up ℤ))]
    [V.mapDerivedCategory.IsRightAdjoint]
    (P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex A ℤ))
    (hres : ∀ K, ∃ (L : CochainComplex A ℤ) (p : L ⟶ K), P L ∧ QuasiIso p)
    (hε : ∀ K, P K → IsIso (ε.app K))
    (H : CochainComplex A ℤ ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (j : 𝟭 (CochainComplex A ℤ) ⟶ H)
    (hH : ∀ {K L : CochainComplex A ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L), QuasiIso f → QuasiIso (H.map f))
    (a : H ⟶ E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ V.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
    (ha : ∀ K, P K → QuasiIso (a.app K)) :
    ∃ (D : DerivedCategory A ⥤ DerivedCategory A)
      (e : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ D ≅ H ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
      (i : 𝟭 (DerivedCategory A) ⟶ D),
      (∀ K, i.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫ e.hom.app K =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (j.app K)) ∧
      ∃ c : D ≅ F ⋙ V.mapDerivedCategory,
        ∀ K : CochainComplex A ℤ,
          c.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≫ V.mapDerivedCategory.map (ε.app K) ≫
            V.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) =
          e.hom.app K ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (a.app K)
